parties.licensor: Data Provider ('Seller', a registered business) - inferred; the document grants no buyer licence
parties.licensee: Data Consumers (buyers) introduced through the platform; not otherwise defined
parties.operator_role: venue (inferred: provider is Seller and may deliver; Opendatabay processes payment and pays out; no broker/agent clause)

term_duration.value: Open-ended while the provider is registered; Opendatabay may suspend or terminate access on breach or harmful behaviour. No provider termination or notice clause.

audit_rights.value: Opendatabay may audit the provider's data sources and request documentation; the provider must cooperate with investigations. No buyer audit right.

warranties_by_provider.value: Provider must own or have permission to sell the data, have collected it lawfully (GDPR, CCPA), not upload infringing or harmful content, and keep datasets complete, safe and accurately described; it bears full responsibility for uploads. Opendatabay gives only a mutual authority warranty.

consent_and_release_warranty.value: Provider-side prohibition only: 'unconsented' data may not be uploaded and data must be lawfully collected under GDPR/CCPA. No mention of people depicted, model or property releases, or passing consent evidence to buyers; the provider may be asked to confirm its rights (separate page) and may be audited.

indemnity.value: Provider indemnifies Opendatabay against third-party claims from its listing (IP infringement, unlawful content, lack of rights). Opendatabay indemnifies the provider only for its own material misrepresentation, payment errors or security failures in its systems. No indemnity to buyers in this document.

liability_cap.value: Mutual cap: each party's aggregate liability limited to platform fees or commissions the provider paid Opendatabay in the prior 12 months; uncapped for fraud, wilful misconduct, personal injury and anything not legally limitable. The cap applies to Opendatabay too, so its own indemnity is capped at fees received.

payment_and_revenue_share.value: Opendatabay processes payment and pays providers out, only to verified business accounts; fee or commission rate is not in this agreement (points to a separate Fees page); fees are non-refundable; off-platform deals with introduced buyers are banned and may incur fees.

takedown_and_erasure.value: Opendatabay may remove content or suppliers for violations; deleted datasets are permanently removed from Opendatabay's systems (minimal metadata up to 100 days). Silent on copies buyers already hold: no buyer deletion or recall obligation.

governing_law.value: Laws of England and Wales; exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of London.

change_of_terms.value: Unilateral: Opendatabay may update at any time, and continued use is acceptance. No notice period.

prohibited_uses.value: Provider may not upload illegal, stolen, scraped, unconsented, malicious, unlicensed or infringing content; may not bypass the platform (external links, direct deals with introduced buyers), exploit bugs, reverse engineer APIs or scrape. Buyer use restrictions are not in this document.

unknowns.note: No clause on training, fine-tuning, evaluation, redistribution or model outputs for datasets; the only AI mention is that listing metadata may be visible to AI models, crawlers or search agents for discovery (c018).
The agreement grants no licence to buyers and does not say who sets the buyer licence or its scope; no field-of-use, territory, sublicensing, derivatives or attribution terms.

Provider is called the 'Seller' and may deliver data itself, while Opendatabay collects fees and pays out; the document never says who is licensor of record to the buyer or that Opendatabay acts as broker or agent.
No licence from provider to Opendatabay to host, sample or distribute the dataset itself; only a marketing licence over name, banners and public product info (c017).

Silent on whether provider listings are exclusive to Opendatabay or whether buyers can get exclusive rights; the only channel restriction is non-circumvention for buyers introduced through the platform (c024).
No warranty about consent or releases of people depicted or property owners, and no obligation to supply consent evidence to buyers or Opendatabay beyond a possible audit.
Removal and deletion provisions cover Opendatabay's systems only; nothing obliges buyers to delete copies already delivered, and no deletion on termination.
Fee structure is incorporated by reference to a separate Fees page, not stated in this agreement.
